A [[human]]<ref name="Justice" /> [[Gender|female]]<ref name="Justice AD" /> who lived on<ref name="Justice" /> the [[planet]] [[Wayyl]],<ref name="CGttSWG" /> this '''villager''' owned a pet [[dog]].<ref name="Justice" /> Between the years [[68 BBY]] and [[58 BBY]]<ref name="Date">"Justice" takes place after [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] became [[Dooku]]'s [[Padawan]]. According to ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'', Jinn becomes Dooku's Padawan in [[68 BBY]] and becomes a [[Jedi Knight]] around [[58 BBY]]. Therefore, {{TOTJ|Justice (episode)}} must take place between those two years.</ref> she was residing in her house when her<ref name="Justice" /> dog went outside, encountering [[Jedi Master]] [[Dooku]] and [[Padawan|Jedi Padawan]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn]], on a [[Mission to rescue Dagonet's son|mission]] to rescue [[Senator]] [[Dagonet]]'s [[Uriel Dagonet|son]], upon seeing the [[Jedi]], the woman closed called the dog inside and closed her doors. Being familar with the villagers who kidnapped Dagonet's son, she led Dagonet and his forces to them and the Jedi, being paid for her services after doing so. She left the scene shortly after. Upon the crisis being resolved, she was seen alongside her dog as the villagers and Dagonet's staff worked on rebuilding the town.<ref name="Justice" />

==Personality and traits==
A human<ref name="Justice" /> female,<ref name="Justice AD" /> the civilian had [[Color|light]] skin, brown hair, and green eyes. Upon gazing eyes upon the Jedi, she seemingly displayed distrust of them, promptly closing her doors. Upon leading Dagonet and his forces to the villagers, the woman showed signs of reluctance, with a [[Unidentified village elder|village elder]] speculating she did it out of desperation. The villager also seemed to have a bond with her pet dog, calling them inside upon encountering the Jedi and bringing them along when leading Dagonet to the villagers.<ref name="Justice" />
